parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminal offence, facility ban, border practice, or documented police targeting/violence against trans visitors is in the dossier, and trans-specific social treatment is undocumented — silence in this thin record is not safety. Extrapolating structurally: same-sex conduct is criminalised under a broad morality provision with episodic but real enforcement (2022 video prosecution; two women arrested June 2024, held to December, convicted and sentenced), penalty unresolved at 6 months to 5 years, government repeatedly refusing decriminalisation, no anti-discrimination protection, no known LGBTQ organisation, widespread impunity, and documented LGBTQ stigmatisation/ostracism with 26% calling their area a good place. If outed, a visitor faces possible arrest/detention and no demonstrated recourse, though no tier-1 universal exposure or organised anti-trans targeting is documented. That hostility plus thin recourse puts it below acceptance-with-protections jurisdictions, but above systematic targeting regimes.
